candidate.answerReason: At \(270^\circ\), the unit-circle point is \((0,-1)\), so its vertical coordinate gives \(\sin270^\circ=-1\).

methods.explanation: The terminal side lies along the negative \(y\)-axis, and the vertical coordinate is \(-1\).
